1	package strategy
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"log/slog"
7		"os/exec"
8		"slices"
9		"strings"
10	
11		"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/logging"
12		"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings"
13	)
14	
15	// CheckpointSyncRemoteSource identifies which precedence rule elected the
16	// checkpoint sync remote.
17	type CheckpointSyncRemoteSource string
18	
19	const (
20		// SyncRemoteSourceConfig: strategy_options.checkpoint_push_remote.
21		SyncRemoteSourceConfig CheckpointSyncRemoteSource = "config"
22		// SyncRemoteSourceDefault: "origin" exists.
23		SyncRemoteSourceDefault CheckpointSyncRemoteSource = "default"
24		// SyncRemoteSourceSole: exactly one remote configured.
25		SyncRemoteSourceSole CheckpointSyncRemoteSource = "sole"
26		// SyncRemoteSourceFirst: first remote in .git/config order.
27		SyncRemoteSourceFirst CheckpointSyncRemoteSource = "first"
28	)
29	
30	// CheckpointSyncRemote is the single git remote elected to carry checkpoint
31	// data. Name is empty when no remotes are configured.
32	type CheckpointSyncRemote struct {
33		Name   string
34		Source CheckpointSyncRemoteSource
35	}
36	
37	// ResolveCheckpointSyncRemote elects the one configured git remote that
38	// checkpoint data syncs to. Pure local lookup — no network. Precedence:
39	// checkpoint_push_remote setting (fail-closed if the named remote does not
40	// exist), then "origin", then the sole remote, then the first remote in
41	// .git/config order. It knows nothing about the checkpoint_remote URL
42	// feature; callers exempt that case themselves.
43	//
44	// Deliberately NOT keyed on the branch's tracking config
45	// (branch.<name>.pushRemote / remote.pushDefault / branch.<name>.remote).
46	// Election is compared against the remote of the push actually being made, so
47	// electing the tracking remote silently drops checkpoint sync on every push to
48	// any OTHER remote — `git push <other> HEAD`, a `git clone -o base` whose
49	// checkpoints go to a separately added origin, any repo with remote.pushDefault
50	// set. TestAlternates_RelativeObjectAlternate_CheckpointSync is the regression:
51	// it clones with `-o base` and pushes checkpoints to `origin`, and a tracking
52	// tier makes the pre-push hook a silent no-op.
53	//
54	// The fork setup that motivated the tracking tier — clone the base repo, add
55	// your fork, push there, with origin unpushable — is served by setting
56	// checkpoint_push_remote explicitly. Reads follow the election: the checkpoint
57	// read paths (resume, explain, discovery) consult the elected remote first and
58	// fall back to origin as a read-only legacy tier (see CheckpointReadRemotes),
59	// so an explicitly elected non-origin remote is fully readable from the same
60	// clone. The tracking tier stays out for the silent-no-op reason above.
61	func ResolveCheckpointSyncRemote(ctx context.Context) (CheckpointSyncRemote, error) {
62		// Fail closed on an unreadable settings file: election must never
63		// override a checkpoint_push_remote the file may contain but we could
64		// not read, or checkpoints would silently re-route away from the remote
65		// the user configured for isolation.
66		s, err := settings.Load(ctx)
67		if err != nil {
68			return CheckpointSyncRemote{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot read settings to resolve the checkpoint sync remote: %w", err)
69		}
70		if name := s.GetCheckpointPushRemote(); name != "" {
71			if !isConfiguredRemote(ctx, name) {
72				return CheckpointSyncRemote{}, fmt.Errorf(
73					"checkpoint_push_remote %q is not a configured git remote; checkpoint sync disabled until fixed", name)
74			}
75			return CheckpointSyncRemote{Name: name, Source: SyncRemoteSourceConfig}, nil
76		}
77	
78		remotes := configuredRemotesInConfigOrder(ctx)
79		switch {
80		case len(remotes) == 0:
81			return CheckpointSyncRemote{}, nil
82		case slices.Contains(remotes, "origin"):
83			return CheckpointSyncRemote{Name: "origin", Source: SyncRemoteSourceDefault}, nil
84		case len(remotes) == 1:
85			return CheckpointSyncRemote{Name: remotes[0], Source: SyncRemoteSourceSole}, nil
86		default:
87			return CheckpointSyncRemote{Name: remotes[0], Source: SyncRemoteSourceFirst}, nil
88		}
89	}
90	
91	// checkpointSyncAllowedForRemote reports whether a push to pushRemote may
92	// carry checkpoint data. False for every remote except the elected
93	// checkpoint sync remote — including raw-URL pushes (git passes the URL as
94	// the hook arg) and the fail-closed misconfigured case. Callers exempt the
95	// dedicated checkpoint_remote URL mode before calling.
96	func checkpointSyncAllowedForRemote(ctx context.Context, pushRemote string) bool {
97		syncRemote, err := ResolveCheckpointSyncRemote(ctx)
98		if err != nil {
99			// Neutral wording: err covers both a misconfigured checkpoint_push_remote
100			// and an unreadable settings file, and the wrapped error already carries
101			// the specifics.
102			logging.Warn(ctx, "checkpoint sync skipped: cannot resolve checkpoint sync remote",
103				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
104			return false
105		}
106		if syncRemote.Name == "" || syncRemote.Name != pushRemote {
107			logging.Debug(ctx, "checkpoint sync skipped: push remote is not the checkpoint sync remote",
108				slog.String("push_remote", pushRemote),
109				slog.String("checkpoint_sync_remote", syncRemote.Name))
110			return false
111		}
112		return true
113	}
